subject: Qualification: deployment mode & PoC plan  Acme Corp
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmecorp.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Qualification: deployment mode & PoC plan  Acme Corp

Thanks again for taking the time today, Alex and Priya  appreciate the walkthrough of your production goals. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we're aligned on scope and expectations for the PoC/trial: 

Summary of customer goals (from the call)
- Primary goal: Validate inference economics and latency at scale for your search & summarization pipelines.
- Traffic profile: peak ~500 req/s, p95 payloads ~350 tokens.
- Security: audit logs, tenant isolation, encryption in transit/at rest required.

Deployment mode decision to confirm
- Hosted API: fastest to iterate, but you flagged data isolation & audit concerns.
- Dedicated capacity: gives predictable throughput and isolated GPU pools  seems like the likely starting point.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): needed if security assessment requires full network isolation; you mentioned this is a fallback.

Proposed PoC / trial plan (attached: redwood-poc-proposal.pdf)
- Duration: 4-6 weeks (target kickoff week of May 3).
- Scope: Dedicated cluster reservation, sample integration with your ML infra, load testing at 500 req/s, end-to-end latency & cost analysis, and verification of audit logs & RBAC.
- Success criteria (please confirm):
  1) Stable throughput at 500 req/s with p95 latency <350ms and p50 <200ms.
  2) End-to-end cost estimate within the threshold you mentioned on the call.
  3) Audit logs and SSO/KMS integration validated with your security team.
  4) No functional regression vs baseline model outputs on our eval set.

Immediate asks for you:
1) Confirm preferred initial deployment mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)  whether we should plan for Dedicated as primary and Private as contingency.
2) Share 1-2 contacts for infra + security (email + best time for a 30m pre-kickoff) so we can lock down cluster sizing and network requirements.
3) Confirm target kickoff week (we proposed May 3).

I've attached our PoC proposal and a short SOC2 summary for your security pre-reads. If Dedicated looks good, we'll draft a minimal mutual action plan with milestones and resource owners.

Thanks 
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood-poc-proposal.pdf, soc2-summary.pdf

Ben  thanks for the recap and the proposal. A few clarifications from our side after internal sync: 

Deployment mode preference
- We want to run the PoC on Dedicated capacity first. Primary reasons: predictable throughput and isolation of resources while we validate at scale.
- Security flagged Private (VPC/on-prem) as the end state if the compliance review requires it, but that would be a longer procurement path.

Stakeholders (please loop in)
- Priya Singh - Head of ML (priya.singh@acmecorp.com) - owning model & metrics.
- Raj Patel - Infra Lead (raj.patel@acmecorp.com) - network, sizing, and on-prem questions.
- Samantha Lee - Security (samantha.lee@acmecorp.com) - will own SOC/KMS signoff (cc'ing her on later threads).

Confirmed success criteria (we agree but will validate internally):
1) Sustained 500 req/s with p95 <350ms (p50 <200ms).
2) Per-token cost projection within 20% of your estimate.
3) Audit logs delivered to our SIEM + SSO/KMS integration validation.
4) No accuracy regression on our evaluation prompts.

Timeline
- Kickoff: week of May 3  we are available Tue/Wed morning PT.
- PoC length: 4-6 weeks depending on network setup and any Private fallback work.

I've attached our internal security notes (we'll share the formal questionnaire); for now, please send any SOC2 summary you have (you already included that).

On the calendar: May 3, 10:00am PT works for us  I’ll send a calendar invite once we confirm your availability.

 Alex
Alex Turner
Director of Product, Acme Corp
alex.turner@acmecorp.com
